CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, January 15, 2025 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member
  Britney Navarro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE NOVEMBER 20, 2024 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  January 15, 2025
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, November 20, 2024
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:04 P.M. on Wednesday, November 20, 2024, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Hermano, and Commission Member Longoria.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Massaro.
Also attending: Director Macias, Recreation Supervisor Amanda Leonard and Clerical Assistant
II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE SEPTEMBER 18, 2024 REGULAR C.A.C.E.
MEETING
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from Commission Member Longoria
the September 18, 2024 minutes were approved.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
Vice President Saunders, Commission Member Longoria and Director Macias agreed to
coordinate a meeting together to discuss utility box art and Alhambra Historical sites after
Thanksgiving. All other City Arts and Cultural Events Commission members are continuing
their research and will provide an update at the next City Arts and Cultural Events Commission
meeting.

STAFF REPORT
Recreation Supervisor Leonard shared how Congress Woman Judy Chu and Supervisor Hilda
Solis presented proclamations at the 2024 Alhambra Veteran’s Day event at Alhambra Park and
on behalf of the City of Alhambra, Council Members Maloney and Andrade-Stadler accepted.

Recreation Supervisor Leonard invited the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission to
participate as judges for the 2024 Alhambra Holiday Home Decorating.

Recreation Supervisor Leonard and Director Macias encouraged the City Arts and Cultural
Events Commission to participate as volunteers and ambassadors for the 2025 Alhambra
Tournament of Roses Parade float decorating.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None.
 COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from Commission Member Hermano,
the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission agreed to postpone the December City Arts and
Cultural Events Commission meeting due to the majority of commission members traveling out
of town for the holidays.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Commission Member Longoria and a second by Commission Member Hermano,
the November 20, 2024 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:17
P.M.
